Custom request envelope, not a complete HTTP/MCP OAuth implementation.

Real ClamAV with harmless custom signature; same-process storage API is not an OS sandbox or a durability guarantee.
Synthetic upload-role and mount-permission fixture only; production services require separate integration.
Optional API component, not automatically wired into HTTP; not a standardized HTTP proof protocol.
Fixed atomic counter; live fixture uses public synthetic password, no production TLS/failover claim.
Database consistency requires database-native snapshot/dump; terminal consumer requires Linux.
Bounded UTF-8 file staging, not arbitrary binary analysis.
Version currency is not proof of vulnerability clearance.
Archive inspection without executing dependencies; AI/manual content review is separate.

Hashes and source stability only; maintainer signature is verified separately.
